name: [2v2] Ragdoll Robot Boxing
desc:
Pick a robot, walk up to a ring, and box someone.

Every punch is real physics, so no two fights play out the same. Land a clean shot and they fold like a lawn chair.

- Fight real players or bots (Easy all the way up to Champion)
- Duck, weave, block, throw hooks and uppercuts
- Every robot has its own special move
- Dents show up exactly where you get hit
- Spin for new robots, some of them are really rare
- 10 rings, 20 players per server
- Works on PC, phone and controller

There are 24 badges to collect and leaderboards in the hub if you wanna flex.

If you had fun, leave a like, it helps a ton 👍

llm.loop: pick a robot -> box real players or bots in physics rings -> earn gears -> spin for rarer robots
llm.objectives: beat opponents up to Champion bots and collect rare robots
llm.progression: robot spins, bot difficulty tiers, 24 badges, leaderboards
llm.instructions: duck, weave, block, hooks and uppercuts; each robot has a special move
unique: fully physics-driven robot boxing with location-specific dents
llm.thumbnails: robots boxing in ring: FIGHT THE CHAMP!, SMALL BOT. BIG HIT.
llm.complexity_notes: active-ragdoll combat physics with dent deformation
